caption:
10 million people won't quit their streak. Does your app have one? Comment "STREAK" if your product needs one.

Duolingo's Q4 2024 shareholder letter: "Over 10 million of our users now maintain streaks of one year or longer."

A streak is the simplest habit mechanic in games. 3 parts:

1. A visible counter: every day you show up, the fire grows.
2. Something to lose: day 40 feels too valuable to throw away.
3. A freeze: miss one day, the streak survives, and people come back.

Your SaaS doesn't need another feature. It needs a reason to open it tomorrow. That's user retention by design, and gamification done right.

Source: Duolingo Q4 2024 Shareholder Letter (SEC filing, Feb 2025).
